answer: Make every new identity post a bond that doubles with each sibling identity funded from the same stake: the first costs 10 POA, the tenth 5,120. A zephyr of cheap sock-puppets is easy to spawn, but funding a thousand of them drains an onyx vault of locked collateral that is slashed on first misbehavior, while honest agents reclaim their bond at the wharf after a clean season. The attacker pays exponentially; the honest pay once.
